title: Machi (Demo)
overview:
Even a passerby you merely brushed past has a story of their own in which they are the protagonist. Why was that person there, and what are they doing?

In the sound novel "Machi," you can follow, zapping between them, the stories of other people you would normally never give a thought to. Enjoy eight dramas of protagonists who, though completely different in purpose and personality, subtly influence one another.

What is a sound novel?
A game you "read," combining the enjoyment of a novel with the cinematic sense of presence created by sound effects. No reflexes or complicated controls are required, so just relax and enjoy it.

あなたにとってただすれ違っただけの通行人でも、その人にはその人が主人公の物語があります。なぜその人がそこにいたのか、何をしているのか？

サウンドノベル「街」では普段であれば気にもしない別の人の物語をザッピング形式で追っていく事が出来ます。目的も性格も全く違いながらも微妙に影響しあう主人公「達」の8つのドラマをお楽しみ下さい。

サウンドノベルとは
小説の面白さに、効果音による映画のような臨場感が加わった、「読む」ゲームです。反射神経や複雑な操作は必要ありませんので気軽にお楽しみ下さい。
